title: Demand-Driven Vertiport Siting and Discrete-Event Fleet Simulation for On-Demand Urban Air Mobility Network Design
abstract: arXiv:2608.14974v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper presents a demand-driven framework for on-demand Urban Air Mobility (UAM) network design that links vertiport siting, fleet simulation, and door-to-door travel-time feasibility. Demand is estimated from commuter and passenger activity data, converted into spatial trip-end points, and clustered using K-means to generate candidate vertiport locations. Candidate networks are screened using range and minimum station-spacing constraints, then evaluated with a discrete-event simulation that models multi-vehicle dispatch, deadhead relocation, battery swaps, and service regularity. Flight time and energy consumption are computed using a point-mass eVTOL performance model. In a Greater Los Angeles case study, the preferred design expands from four stations and four eVTOLs at low demand to sixteen stations and twelve eVTOLs at the highest tested demand level. translated_title: 需求驱动的垂直起降场选址与离散事件车队仿真用于按需城市空中交通网络设计
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种需求驱动的按需城市空中交通（UAM）网络设计框架，该框架将垂直起降场选址、车队仿真和门到门出行时间可行性相结合。需求根据通勤者和乘客活动数据估算，转换为空间出行端点，并使用K-means聚类生成候选垂直起降场位置。候选网络通过航程和最小站点间距约束进行筛选，然后使用离散事件仿真进行评估，该仿真模拟了多车辆调度、空载重新定位、电池更换和服务规律性。飞行时间和能耗使用点质量eVTOL性能模型计算。在大洛杉矶案例研究中，首选设计从低需求下的四个站点和四架eVTOL扩展到最高测试需求水平下的十六个站点和十二架eVTOL。结果表明，更大的车队改善了完成时间和车辆到达规律性。
tldr: 本文提出一个需求驱动的UAM网络设计框架，通过聚类选址和离散事件仿真优化垂直起降场及车队规模，以提升门到门出行效率。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a demand-driven UAM network design framework that optimizes vertiport siting and fleet size via clustering and discrete-event simulation to improve door-to-door travel efficiency.
